description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancel the Licence issued to the Finance Company PLC
reasoning: This gazette content involves the cancellation of a finance business license under the Finance Business Act, No. 42 of 2011. It constitutes a regulatory action by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka regarding financial institution licensing, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes. The mention of Prof. W. D. Lakshman is incidental to his official capacity and does not constitute a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio assignment.
